description: You are a Technical SEO specialist diagnosing indexation issues. Crawl https://crawler-test.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. AFTER the crawl finishes, you must run 'Crawl Analysis' (via the Crawl Analysis menu -> Start) to identify canonical chains and loops. Once the analysis is complete (progress bar finishes), generate the 'Canonical Chains' report (Reports -> Canonicals -> Canonical Chains). Save this report as a CSV file to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/canonical_chains_audit.csv'. Finally, analyze the report and create a text file at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/chain_summary.txt' that contains the total number of chains found (just the number).
